title: Version claim: '2.2 stable line' is stale
reality: Current stable is v2.3.3 (releases 2.3.0–2.3.3 shipped; 2.3.3 changelog synchronizes release identity as v2.3.3 across Engine, PWA manifest, installers, Android APK).
fix: In 'Honesty about the engine's limits', change 'on its 2.2 stable line' to 'on its 2.3 stable line (2.3.3 at last sync)'.

title: 'No plugin marketplace' limit is now wrong
reality: v2.3.0 added a full-page Agents → Download Agents library backed by the official Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog of 29 individually verified first-party packages (Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, Conversation games), with Install/Uninstall All, startup auto-upgrade (2.3.1), and compatibility-aware catalog lanes per Engine major (2.3.3 #3712). CSS/JS client extensions remain manually installed files.
fix: Rewrite the limits bullet to: official downloadable Agent packages now exist via Agents → Download Agents (29-package verified catalog from Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents, auto-updating, compatibility-lane aware); but there is still no marketplace for client CSS/JS extensions — those are still distributed and installed manually.

title: '22 built-in agents' reference-table row is stale
reality: v2.3.0 moved optional agents into downloadable packages; fresh installs contain NO optional agents; existing installs migrate. The catalog holds 29 packages; >25,000 lines of built-in agent code were removed from the base Engine.
fix: Change the 'Agents — the 22 built-ins...' table row to something like 'Agents — the downloadable-package model (29-package official catalog, fresh installs have none preinstalled), custom agents, phases (pre-gen / parallel / post-proc), overriding agent prompts'.

title: Decision hierarchy missing 'official package already does this?' step
reality: Since v2.3.0 the first-party catalog covers common wants (maps/state tracking, calls, image/video via Illustrator, music via Music DJ, card evolution, lorebook keeping, table games). Professor Mari herself now carries a canonical 29-package catalog summary to recommend packages. Building a custom agent/tool for something an official package already does is now the wrong first move.
fix: Insert a step in the SKILL.md 'Decision hierarchy': 'Does an official downloadable agent package already do this? Check Agents → Download Agents (Writer/Tracker/Misc/Maps/Calls/games) before building custom.' Also add a matching ideation anti-pattern ('I'll hand-build an agent that Hierarchical Maps / Music DJ / Illustrator already provides').

title: Limits list: 'can't hook the pipeline without forking' needs package-API nuance
reality: v2.3.2 (#3690) added capability API 1.3 host services for downloadable packages (safe model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading). The base Engine now exposes validated capability registries and compatibility bridges; packages supply feature code, slash commands, and client surfaces. Package authorship goes through the Marinara-Agents repo, not forking the Engine.
fix: Update the 'Core prompt assembly pipeline isn't user-extensible' limit to note the exception: official capability packages plug in via the capability API (1.3) with host services and can contribute commands/runtimes/client UI; arbitrary user code still can't hook prompt assembly outside that packaging path.

title: Contributor mode missing Marinara-Agents as a second contribution surface
reality: v2.3.0 published first-party agents in the separate Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repository with its own contribution rules, issue and PR templates, catalog validation, protected review flow, and automatic CodeRabbit review. Agent-package work is contribution work but does not go through the Marinara-Engine repo/staging-branch workflow.
fix: In Mode B, add a short subsection: changes to official downloadable agent packages target github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents (own templates, catalog validation, protected review, CodeRabbit); the Engine-repo rules (staging base branch, pnpm check trio, version:sync) apply only to Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine. Also update mode-detection guidance so 'I want to fix/extend an official agent package' is recognized as contributor work aimed at the Agents repo.

title: Calls/video reference-table row treats Calls as a built-in engine feature
reality: v2.3.0 moved Conversation audio/video calls into an optional downloadable package ('Conversation Calls', renamed user-facing to 'Calls' in 2.3.2 #3676). Local Whisper is now a Calls-owned download: Connections shows Local Speech Model controls only while the package is installed, and uninstalling removes downloaded Whisper models.
fix: Update the SKILL.md reference-table row 'Conversation audio/video calls, character video presence...' to note Calls is a downloadable package (user-facing name 'Calls') and that Local Whisper models are owned by it; keep the pointer to architecture.md.

title: New env vars CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED unknown to skill
reality: v2.3.3 (#3730) added CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS (for slow Conversation/Roleplay/Game providers) and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false (persistent launcher update opt-out on Windows/macOS/Linux/Termux without disabling manual updates); both belong in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
fix: Mention both env vars where the skill discusses env/config knowledge (the docs/CONFIGURATION.md bullet in 'Update affected docs' and/or a troubleshooting note: slow-provider timeouts → CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS; launcher auto-update opt-out → AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false).

title: Version-drift section lacks current Android versionCode baseline
reality: Per the 2.3.x changelogs, Android versionCode is now 38 at v2.3.3 (34 at 2.3.0, 35 at 2.3.1, 37 at 2.3.2), so the next shipped APK must use >=39. The 2.3.2/2.3.3 sync scope also names the Home release link and What's New announcement as version-identity surfaces.
fix: In 'Version drift', add a note that versionCode is 38 as of v2.3.3 (next release must increment past it), and note that release-identity sync now also covers the Home release link / What's New announcement — verify current surfaces in the repo when cutting a release.

title: Professor Mari shortcut note missing v2.3 Mari capabilities
reality: v2.3.2 moved Conversation About Me drafting from per-editor AI Write to Professor Mari (she inspects a saved character/persona, writes the bio in their voice, and saves it to the real About Me field); v2.3.0 gave Mari the canonical 29-package catalog summary so she can compare/recommend every downloadable agent package; a version-aware What's New window introduces releases.
fix: Extend the 'In-app shortcut' callout: as of 2.3, Mari also drafts/saves Conversation About Me bios (the per-editor AI Write controls are gone) and can recommend official downloadable agent packages from the 29-package catalog.

title: Stale '2.2' phrasing in calibration and 'When you don't know' examples
reality: Examples read 'does feature X exist in 2.2 yet?' and 'does 2.2.x have feature X yet?'; current line is 2.3.x.
fix: Update both example strings to reference 2.3.x.

title: Q8 media generation ignores the Illustrator package requirement
reality: v2.3.0: image/video generation is now owned by the downloadable Illustrator agent (Visual Generation renamed to Illustrator; selfie configuration renamed Illustrator Settings). Gallery actions (Illustrate, Selfie, Storyboard, Video, Animate, Background) and the /illustrate and /selfie commands appear only when Illustrator is installed and enabled for the chat; the Connections defaults category was renamed from Illustrator to Images.
fix: Rewrite Q8 (and the Q4 cross-reference): media generation requires installing the official Illustrator agent package via Agents → Download Agents, then attaching an image/Video Generation connection (Connections → Images category); still not a webhook tool. Note the Illustrator Settings location in Chat Settings → Agents.

title: Nine Questions missing an 'official downloadable package first' gate
reality: Since v2.3.0, 29 verified first-party packages (Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, Conversation games — e.g. Hierarchical Maps, Music DJ, Card Evolution, Lorebook Keeper, Illustrator) install from Agents → Download Agents; fresh installs contain none, so users must be pointed at the catalog. v2.3.2 (#3692) also lets selected custom agents run in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game whenever Enable Agents is on.
fix: Add a question before Q5 (custom agents): 'Does an official downloadable agent package already do this? Check Agents → Download Agents before building a custom agent or tool.' In Q5, note custom agents now run in all three chat modes when Enable Agents is on, and that Maps/Calls/games are packages, not built-ins.

title: Game mode description missing Tactical Combat preference
reality: v2.3.0 added a Combat Preference chosen in the Game setup wizard and changeable in Chat Settings → Combat Style: classic narrative combat, or a tactical grid-based battle style (terrain-painted battlefield, unit classes, movement/attack ranges, counters/crits/misses, deterministic seeded enemy phase, four difficulty levels).
fix: In the 'First: which chat mode?' Game bullet, add that Game mode offers a Combat Preference — narrative vs Tactical Combat (grid-tactics battles, seeded deterministic engine, 4 difficulty levels) — selectable at setup or later via Chat Settings → Combat Style.

title: Q8 call-avatar surface uses pre-rename Calls framing
reality: 'Conversation-call video presence' is a surface of the downloadable Calls package (moved to a package in 2.3.0, renamed from Conversation Calls to Calls in 2.3.2 #3676); it does not exist unless Calls is installed.
fix: In Q8's surface list, rename 'Conversation-call video presence' to 'Calls video presence' and note it requires the downloadable Calls package installed.

title: Noodle bullet slightly stale on v2.3 additions
reality: v2.3.0 added an editable Noodle Prompt (full default with one-click restore) and a default-on setting excluding Professor Mari from Noodle discovery/generation (#3598); v2.3.2 gave Noodle 8,192-token world/lore and carryover budgets and smarter participant/profile selection.
fix: Append to the Noodle mode bullet: the Noodle system prompt is now user-editable in Noodle Settings (with default restore), and Professor Mari is excluded from the timeline by default.
